36template <typename TState, typename TEvent> class beerocks_fsm_transition {
37 // Public methods:
38public:
39 // Constructor
40 beerocks_fsm_transition(const TState &source, const TState &destination, const TEvent &event)
41 : m_source(source), m_destination(destination), m_event(event)
42 {
43 }
44
45 // Getter methods
46 const TState &source() const { return m_source; }
47 const TState &destination() const { return m_destination; }
48 const TEvent &event() const { return m_event; }
49
50 // Update the destination of the transition (not the default state)
51 bool change_destination(const TState &dest)
52 {
53 LOG(INFO) << "'" << m_source << "': Overriding destination for '" << m_event << "' from '"
54 << m_destination << "' to '" << dest << "'";
55
56 m_destination = dest;
57 return true;
58 }
59
60 // Private data-members:
61private:
62 // Source state
63 const TState m_source;
64
65 // Destination state
66 TState m_destination;
67
68 // Event (trigger)
69 const TEvent m_event;
70};

75template <typename TState, typename TEvent> class beerocks_fsm_event {
76 // Public definitions:
77public:
78 // FSM transition
79 using TTransition = beerocks_fsm_transition<TState, TEvent>;
80
81 // FSM transition condition function
82 using TCondition = std::function<bool(TTransition &, const void *)>;
83
84 // Public methods:
85public:
86 // Constructor
87 beerocks_fsm_event(const TEvent &event, const std::list<TState> &target_states,
88 const TCondition &cond)
89 : m_event(event), m_allowed_states(target_states), m_cond(cond)
90 {
91 }
92
93 // Getter methods
94 const TEvent &event() const { return m_event; }
95 const TState &target_state() const
96 {
97 // Return the default state
98 return m_allowed_states.front();
99 }
100
101 // Check the event transition condition
102 bool check_condition(TTransition &transition, const void *args = nullptr)
103 {
104 // Support empty conditions
105 if (!m_cond)
106 return true;
107
108 TState org_dest = transition.destination();
109
110 // Evaluate the condition
111 if (!m_cond(transition, args))
112 return false;
113
114 // In case the destination state was modified by the condition function,
115 // check the new destination is allowed...
116 if (org_dest != transition.destination()) {
117 if (std::find(m_allowed_states.begin(), m_allowed_states.end(),
118 transition.destination()) == m_allowed_states.end()) {
119 LOG(ERROR) << "Invalid transition from state '" << transition.source()
120 << "' to state '" << transition.destination() << "'";
121
122 return false;
123 }
124 }
125
126 return true;
127 }
128
129 // Private data-members:
130private:
131 // Event
132 TEvent m_event;
133
134 // Allowed target states for the current event
135 std::list<TState> m_allowed_states;
136
137 // Event transition function
138 TCondition m_cond;
139};

145template <typename TState, typename TEvent> class beerocks_fsm_state {
146 // Public definitions:
147public:
148 // FSM Event Handler
149 typedef beerocks_fsm_event<TState, TEvent> TEventHandler;
150
151 // Simple (non-transional) action
152 typedef std::function<bool(const void *)> TAction;
153
154 // Inherited types
155 typedef typename TEventHandler::TTransition TTransition;
156 typedef typename TEventHandler::TCondition TTransAction;
157
158 // Public methods:
159public:
160 // Constructor
161 explicit beerocks_fsm_state(const TState &state) : m_state(state) {}
162
163 // Set handler for state entry
164 void set_entry_action(const TAction &action) { m_entry_action = action; }
165
166 // Set handler for state exit
167 void set_exit_action(const TAction &action) { m_exit_action = action; }
168
169 // Add state event handler
170 void add_event(const std::shared_ptr<TEventHandler> &event_handler)
171 {
172 if (!event_handler) {
173 LOG(FATAL) << "Invalid event handler pointer!";
174 }
175
176 if (m_events.find(event_handler->event()) != m_events.end()) {
177 LOG(FATAL) << "Event '" << event_handler->event() << "' for State '" << m_state
178 << "' already exists!";
179 }
180
181 // Add the event
182 m_events[event_handler->event()] = event_handler;
183 }
184
185 // Handle state entry
186 bool enter(const void *args = nullptr) const
187 {
188 // Allow empty entry actions
189 if (!m_entry_action)
190 return true;
191 return (m_entry_action(args));
192 }
193
194 // Handle state exit
195 bool exit(const void *args = nullptr) const
196 {
197 // Allow empty exit actions
198 if (!m_exit_action)
199 return true;
200 return (m_exit_action(args));
201 }
202
203 // Check whether the current state can handle the given event
204 bool can_handle(const TEvent &event) { return (m_events.find(event) != m_events.end()); }
205
206 // Process an event and return the next state
207 const TState handle(const TEvent &event, const void *args = nullptr)
208 {
209 // Check if the given event was registered for this state
210 auto iter = m_events.find(event);
211 if (iter == m_events.end()) {
212 LOG(WARNING) << "State '" << m_state << "' can't handle event '" << event << "'";
213 return m_state;
214 }
215
216 // Construct a new transition object and execute the event condition function
217 auto trigger_handler = iter->second;
218 TTransition transition(m_state, trigger_handler->target_state(), event);
219 if (trigger_handler->check_condition(transition, args)) {
220 return transition.destination();
221 }
222
223 // Remain in the current state
224 return m_state;
225 }
226
227 // Private data-members:
228private:
229 // State
230 const TState m_state;
231
232 // Entry/Exit functions
233 TAction m_entry_action;
234 TAction m_exit_action;
235
236 // Map of allowed state events
237 //std::unordered_map<TEvent, std::shared_ptr<TEventHandler>> m_events;
238 TypedUnorderedMap<TEvent, std::shared_ptr<TEventHandler>> m_events;
239};

244template <typename TState, typename TEvent> class beerocks_fsm_config {
245 // Public definitions
246public:
247 typedef beerocks_fsm_state<TState, TEvent> TStateHandler;
248
249 // Inherited types
250 typedef typename TStateHandler::TTransition TTransition;
251 typedef typename TStateHandler::TTransAction TTransAction;
252 typedef typename TStateHandler::TAction TAction;
253 typedef typename TStateHandler::TEventHandler TEventHandler;
254
255 // Pointer to state handler class
256 typedef std::shared_ptr<TStateHandler> TStateHandlerPtr;
257
258 // Configuration states structure
259 //typedef std::unordered_map<TState, std::shared_ptr<TStateHandler>> TConfStates;
260 typedef TypedUnorderedMap<TState, std::shared_ptr<TStateHandler>> TConfStates;
261
262 // Public methods
263public:
264 // Configure current state
265 beerocks_fsm_config &state(const TState &state)
266 {
267 // Make sure the state doesn't exists in the configuration
268 if (m_states.find(state) != m_states.end()) {
269 LOG(FATAL) << "State '" << state << "' already exists in the configuration!";
270 }
271
272 // Create new state
273 m_curr_state = std::make_shared<TStateHandler>(state);
274 m_states[state] = m_curr_state;
275
276 return *this;
277 };
278
279 // Set entry function
280 beerocks_fsm_config &entry(const TAction &action)
281 {
282 if (!m_curr_state) {
283 LOG(FATAL) << "Invalid state handler!";
284 }
285
286 m_curr_state->set_entry_action(action);
287 return *this;
288 };
289
290 // Set exit function
291 beerocks_fsm_config &exit(const TAction &action)
292 {
293 if (!m_curr_state) {
294 LOG(FATAL) << "Invalid state handler!";
295 }
296
297 m_curr_state->set_exit_action(action);
298 return *this;
299 };
300
301 // Configure event handling logic
302 beerocks_fsm_config &on(const TEvent &event, const std::list<TState> &states,
303 const TTransAction &cond = {})
304 {
305 if (!m_curr_state) {
306 LOG(FATAL) << "Invalid state handler!";
307 }
308
309 if (!states.size()) {
310 LOG(FATAL) << "At least 1 target state should be defined for event '" << event << "'";
311 }
312
313 // Create an event handler and add it to the state
314 auto event_handler = std::make_shared<TEventHandler>(event, states, cond);
315 m_curr_state->add_event(event_handler);
316
317 return *this;
318 };
319
320 beerocks_fsm_config &on(const TEvent &trigger, const TState &state,
321 const TTransAction &cond = {})
322 {
323 return on(trigger, std::list<TState>({state}), cond);
324 };
325
326 // Return a list of configured states
327 const TConfStates &states() const { return m_states; }
328
329private:
330 // States
331 TConfStates m_states;
332
333 // Current state (used during configuration)
334 TStateHandlerPtr m_curr_state;
335};

340template <typename TState, typename TEvent> class beerocks_fsm {
341 // Public definitions
342public:
343 // FSM Configuration
344 typedef beerocks_fsm_config<TState, TEvent> TConfiguration;
345 typedef typename TConfiguration::TTransition TTransition;
346
347 // Public methods
348public:
349 // Constructor
350 explicit beerocks_fsm(TState init_state)
351 : m_init_state(init_state), m_curr_state(init_state), m_started(false)
352 {
353 }
354
355 // FSM Configuration
356 TConfiguration &config() { return m_config; }
357
358 // Return current FSM state
359 const TState &state() const { return m_curr_state; }
360
361 // Initialize the FSM
362 bool start(const void *args = nullptr)
363 {
364 if (m_started) {
365 LOG(WARNING) << "FSM already started";
366 return true;
367 }
368
369 // Make sure that the initial state is configured
370 auto iter = m_config.states().find(m_init_state);
371 if (iter == m_config.states().end()) {
372 LOG(FATAL) << "Invalid initial state '" << m_init_state << "'";
373 return false;
374 }
375
376 auto state_handler = iter->second;
377 m_started = true;
378
379 // Enter the initial state
380 return state_handler->enter(args);
381 }
382
383 // Handle event
384 bool fire(const TEvent &event, const void *args = nullptr)
385 {
386 if (!m_started) {
387 LOG(ERROR) << "FSM not started!";
388 return false;
389 }
390
391 // Find the current state
392 auto iter = m_config.states().find(m_curr_state);
393 if (iter == m_config.states().end()) {
394 LOG(FATAL) << "Invalid state '" << m_curr_state << "'";
395 return false;
396 }
397
398 // Check if the state is able to handle the given event
399 auto state_handler = iter->second;
400 if (!state_handler->can_handle(event)) {
401 LOG(WARNING) << "Current state '" << m_curr_state << "' unable to handle event '"
402 << event << "'";
403 return false;
404 }
405
406 // Handle the event
407 auto new_state = state_handler->handle(event, args);
408
409 // Check if the FSM should switch to a new state
410 if (new_state != m_curr_state) {
411
412 // Exit current state
413 state_handler->exit(args);
414
415 // Check if the new state is configured
416 iter = m_config.states().find(new_state);
417 if (iter == m_config.states().end()) {
418 LOG(ERROR) << "Unable to transition to undefined state '" << new_state << "'";
419 return false;
420 }
421 state_handler = iter->second;
422
423 // Enter the new state
424 state_handler->enter(args);
425 m_curr_state = new_state;
426 }
427
428 return true;
429 }
430
431 // Private data-members:
432private:
433 // Initial state
434 const TState m_init_state;
435
436 // Current state
437 TState m_curr_state;
438
439 // FSM Started
440 bool m_started = false;
441
442 // FSM Configuration
443 TConfiguration m_config;
444};
